scientific.label: Elevation
scientific.title: Color shows height above the PDS 561.4 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.58 km grid spacing. The globe uses a simplified version of the released Q128 shape; grid and geometry resolutions differ. Model detail and accuracy vary.

scientific.label: Relative albedo
scientific.title: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Dione orbit plus VSOP87 Saturn position and IAU/WGCCRE Dione rotation

panel.introduction: An icy moon of Saturn with bright ice cliffs and long fractures crossing ancient cratered plains and smoother terrain. The shape view reveals a simplified Cassini SPC model. Relative albedo shows the model’s brightness variation; elevation uses its own stated reference sphere.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Cassini/Voyager mosaic, about 154 m per source pixel, downsampled to the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows adds approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.title: Global image mosaic
controls.summary: Detail varies across images from two missions. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing observations.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 enhanced-color composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Colors extend beyond human vision into ultraviolet and infrared. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.title: Enhanced-color composite
controls.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. The 2014 composite retains shading and seams.
